[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    int a = 10;
    double b = 3.5;
    unsigned long c = 20UL;

     
    std::cout << "Values: ";
    for (auto val : {a, b, c}) {
        std::cout << val << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto result1 = a + static_cast<int>(b);  
    auto result2 = b + static_cast<double>(c);  
    auto result3 = c - static_cast<unsigned long>(a);  

    std::cout << "Arithmetic results: ";
    std::cout << result1 << " " << result2 << " " << result3 << std::endl;

     
    if (result1 == static_cast<int>(result2)) {
        std::cout << "Comparison: true" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparison: false" << std::endl;
    }

     
    auto compareBool = static_cast<bool>(result1 != result3);

int main() {
    int a = 10;
    double b = 20.5;
    unsigned long c = 30L;

    std::cout << "Initial values: " << a << ", " << b << ", " << c << std::endl;

     
    auto sum = a + static_cast<int>(b) + static_cast<unsigned long>(c);
    double product = b * static_cast<double>(a) / c;

    std::cout << "Sum: " << sum << ", Product: " << product << std::endl;

     
    int arr[] = {1, 2, 3};
    for (auto val : arr) {
        std::cout << "Array value: " << val << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (sum == static_cast<int>(product)) {
        std::cout << "Sum equals casted product" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Sum does not equal casted product" << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            int result = arr[i] * static_cast<double>(b);
            std::cout << "Nested loop result: " << result << std::endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
int main() {
    int a = 5;
    double b = 3.2;
    unsigned long c = 10;
    auto sum = static_cast<double>(a) + b + static_cast<double>(c);
    auto product = static_cast<unsigned long>(a) * c;
    auto difference = b - static_cast<int>(c);
    std::cout << "Sum: " << sum << "\n";
    std::cout << "Product: " << product << "\n";
    std::cout << "Difference: " << difference << "\n";
    int arr[] = {a, static_cast<int>(b), static_cast<int>(c)};
    for (auto val : arr) {
        std::cout << "Value: " << val << "\n";
    }
    if (sum == a + b + c) {
        std::cout << "Sum comparison passed\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Sum comparison failed\n";
    }
    if (product != a * b) {
        std::cout << "Product comparison passed\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Product comparison failed\n";
    }
    int arr2[] = {1, 2, 3};
    for (auto val : arr2) {
        std::cout << "Array value: " << val << "\n";
    }
    if (sum == static_cast<int>(product)) {
        std::cout << "Sum equals casted product" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Sum does not equal casted product" << std::endl;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            int result = arr2[i] * static_cast<double>(b);
            std::cout << "Nested loop result: " << result << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

            std::cout << "Unsigned long subtraction: " << result3 << std::endl;
        }
    }

     
    int comparison_int = 6;
    double comparison_double = 8.0;
    unsigned long comparison_ulong = 4;

    if (comparison_int == static_cast<int>(comparison_double)) {  
        std::cout << "Comparison: int and double are equal after promotion." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparison: int and double are not equal." << std::endl;
    }

    if (comparison_ulong != static_cast<double>(comparison_ulong)) {  
        std::cout << "Comparison: unsigned long and double are not equal." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparison: unsigned long and double are equal." << std::endl;
    }
}

    std::cout << "Sum: " << sum << std::endl;

     
    if (sum == a + b + c) {
        std::cout << "Equal" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Not Equal" << std::endl;
    }

     
    int sum_int = static_cast<int>(sum);
    if (sum_int == a + b + c) {
        std::cout << "Equal after type casting" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Not Equal after type casting" << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    int a = 5;
    double b = 3.14;
    unsigned long c = 2000000000UL;

     
    auto arr = {a, static_cast<int>(b), static_cast<int>(c)};

     
    for (const auto& val : arr) {
        std::cout << "Value: " << val;
        
        if (&val == &a) {
            std::cout << ", Address of a";
        } else if (&val == &b) {
            std::cout << ", Address of b (promoted to double)";
        } else if (&val == &c) {
            std::cout << ", Address of c (promoted to int)";
        }

         
        auto sum = val + static_cast<int>(b);
        auto diff = val - static_cast<int>(b);
        auto product = val * b;
        auto quotient = val / 2.0;  

        std::cout << ", Sum with b: " << sum;
        std::cout << ", Diff with b: " << diff;
        std::cout << ", Product with b: " << product;
        std::cout << ", Quotient by 2.0: " << quotient;

         
        if (sum == static_cast<int>(val + b)) {
            std::cout << ", Sum comparison OK";
        } else {
            std::cout << ", Sum comparison FAILED";
        }

        if (diff != 0) {
            std::cout << ", Diff comparison OK";
        } else {
            std::cout << ", Diff comparison FAILED";
        }

        if (product == val * b) {
            std::cout << ", Product comparison OK";
        } else {
            std::cout << ", Product comparison FAILED";
        }

        if (quotient == static_cast<double>(val) / 2.0) {
            std::cout << ", Quotient comparison OK";
        } else {
            std::cout << ", Quotient comparison FAILED";
        }

        std::cout << std::endl;
    }

    double b = 3.14;
    unsigned long c = 2000000000;

     
    std::initializer_list<std::variant<int, double, unsigned long>> values = {a, b, c};

     
    for (const auto& value : values) {
        if (std::holds_alternative<int>(value)) {
            int val = std::get<int>(value);
            std::cout << "Int: " << val << ", ";
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<double>(value)) {
            double val = std::get<double>(value);
            std::cout << "Double: " << val << ", ";
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<unsigned long>(value)) {
            unsigned long val = std::get<unsigned long>(value);
            std::cout << "Unsigned Long: " << val << ", ";
        }
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto sum = [](auto x, auto y) { return x + y; };
    auto product = [](auto x, auto y) { return x * y; };
    auto difference = [](auto x, auto y) { return x - y; };
    auto quotient = [](auto x, auto y) { return x / y; };

    std::cout << "Sum: " << sum(a, b) << ", ";
    std::cout << "Product: " << product(b, c) << ", ";
    std::cout << "Difference: " << difference(c, a) << ", ";
    std::cout << "Quotient: " << quotient(b, static_cast<double>(a)) << std::endl;

     
    int result1 = sum(a, b);
    double result2 = product(b, c);
    unsigned long result3 = difference(c, a);
    double result4 = quotient(b, static_cast<double>(a));

    if (result1 == static_cast<int>(sum(a, b))) {
        std::cout << "Sum comparison passed" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Sum comparison failed" << std::endl;
    }

    if (result2 != product(b, c)) {
        std::cout << "Product comparison failed" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Product comparison passed" << std::endl;
    }

    if (result3 == difference(c, a)) {
        std::cout << "Difference comparison passed" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Difference comparison failed" << std::endl;
    }

    if (result4 != quotient(b, static_cast<double>(a))) {
        std::cout << "Quotient comparison failed" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Quotient comparison passed" << std::endl;
    }

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        int* ptr;
        Resource(int val = 0) : ptr(new int(val)) {}
        ~Resource() { delete ptr; }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    Resource res(42);

     
    auto lambda = [res]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << *(res.ptr) << std::endl;
    };

     
    lambda();

     
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        std::string name;
        explicit Resource(const std::string& n) : name(n) {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' constructed.\n";
        }
        ~Resource() {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' destructed.\n";
        }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : name(std::move(other.name)) {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' moved.\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                name = std::move(other.name);
                std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' move assigned.\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
         
        Resource(const Resource& other) : name(other.name) {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' copied.\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                name = other.name;
                std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' copy assigned.\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    Resource res1("first");
    {
        Resource res2 = res1;   
        std::cout << "Inside inner block, res2 is a copy of res1.\n";
    }
    Resource res3 = std::move(res1);   
    std::cout << "After moving res1 to res3, res1 has been moved out.\n";

     
    auto lambda = [](Resource r) {
        std::cout << "Lambda received a resource with name: '" << r.name << "'.\n";
    };
    lambda(res3);   

}

// BEGIN C++ PROGRAM
#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct ResourceGuard {
        double value;
        ResourceGuard(double v = 0.0) : value(v) { std::cout << "Resource acquired with value: " << value << "\n"; }
        ~ResourceGuard() { std::cout << "Resource released for value: " << value << "\n"; }
        ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard& other) : value(other.value) { std::cout << "Resource copied from value: " << other.value << "\n"; }
        ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept : value(other.value) { other.value = 0.0; std::cout << "Resource moved from value: " << value << "\n"; }
    };
    struct Resource {
        std::string name;
        explicit Resource(const std::string& n) : name(n) {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' constructed.\n";
        }
        ~Resource() {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' destructed.\n";
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : name(std::move(other.name)) {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' moved.\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                name = std::move(other.name);
                std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' move assigned.\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : name(other.name) {
            std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' copied.\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                name = other.name;
                std::cout << "Resource '" << name << "' copy assigned.\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };
    ResourceGuard rg1(42.5);
    auto lambda = [rg = std::move(rg1)]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << rg.value << "\n";
    };
    lambda();
    Resource res1("first");
    {
        Resource res2 = res1;   
        std::cout << "Inside inner block, res2 is a copy of res1.\n";
    }
    Resource res3 = std::move(res1);   
    std::cout << "After moving res1 to res3, res1 has been moved out.\n";
    auto lambda_resource = [](Resource r) {
        std::cout << "Lambda received a resource with name: '" << r.name << "'.\n";
    };
    lambda_resource(res3);   
}

#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        int *data;
        Resource() : data(new int[10]) {}
        ~Resource() { delete[] data; }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(new int[10]) {
            std::copy(other.data, other.data + 10, data);
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) {
            other.data = nullptr;
        }
    };
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        Resource res;
        auto lambda = [res]() {
            std::cout << "Inside lambda, accessing resource...\n";
        };
        lambda();
    }
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct ResourceGuard {
        int* ptr;
        
         
        ResourceGuard() : ptr(new int(0)) {}
        
         
        ~ResourceGuard() {
            delete ptr;
        }
        
         
        ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) {}
        
         
        ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
        }
        
         
        ResourceGuard& operator=(const ResourceGuard& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = new int(*other.ptr);
            }
            return *this;
        }
        
         
        ResourceGuard& operator=(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };
    
     
    ResourceGuard guard1;
    
     
    auto lambda = [guard1]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, accessing copied resource: " << *guard1.ptr << std::endl;
    };
    
     
    lambda();

// BEGIN C++ PROGRAM
#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        int* data;
        Resource(int value = 0) : data(new int(value)) {
            std::cout << "Resource allocated with value " << *data << "\n";
        }
        ~Resource() {
            delete data;
            std::cout << "Resource deallocated\n";
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) {
            other.data = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete data;
                data = other.data;
                other.data = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource move assigned\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };
    {
        Resource res(42);
    }
    auto lambda = [res_captured = Resource(10)](int x) mutable {
        std::cout << "Lambda captured value: " << *res_captured.data << "\n";
    };
    lambda(42);
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    constexpr unsigned long long fibonacci(unsigned int n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        if (n == 1) return 1;
        unsigned long long a = 0, b = 1, c;
        for (unsigned int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            c = a + b;
            a = b;
            b = c;
        }
        return b;
    }

     
    template <unsigned long long N>
    struct Fibonacci {
        static constexpr unsigned long long value = fibonacci(N);
    };

     
    static_assert(Fibonacci<10>::value == 55, "Fibonacci number at position 10 is incorrect");

     
    std::cout << "The Fibonacci number at position 10 is: " << Fibonacci<10>::value << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    constexpr unsigned long long factorial(unsigned int n) {
        return n <= 1 ? 1 : n * factorial(n - 1);
    }

    static_assert(factorial(5) == 120, "Factorial of 5 should be 120");

    constexpr unsigned long long fibonacci(unsigned int n) {
        return n <= 1 ? n : fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2);
    }

    static_assert(fibonacci(10) == 55, "Fibonacci of 10 should be 55");

    constexpr unsigned long long power(unsigned int base, unsigned int exp) {
        return exp == 0 ? 1 : base * power(base, exp - 1);
    }

    static_assert(power(2, 3) == 8, "2 to the power of 3 should be 8");

    constexpr unsigned long long sum_of_series(unsigned int n) {
        return n == 0 ? 0 : n + sum_of_series(n - 1);
    }

    static_assert(sum_of_series(10) == 55, "Sum of series up to 10 should be 55");

    constexpr unsigned long long gcd(unsigned int a, unsigned int b) {
        return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    static_assert(gcd(48, 18) == 6, "GCD of 48 and 18 should be 6");

    constexpr unsigned long long lcm(unsigned int a, unsigned int b) {
        return (a / gcd(a, b)) * b;
    }

    static_assert(lcm(15, 20) == 60, "LCM of 15 and 20 should be 60");

    constexpr unsigned long long binomial_coefficient(unsigned int n, unsigned int k) {
        if (k > n) return 0;
        if (k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
        return binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1) + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k);
    }

    static_assert(binomial_coefficient(5, 2) == 10, "Binomial coefficient of 5 choose 2 should be 10");

    constexpr bool is_prime(unsigned int n) {
        if (n <= 1) return false;
        for (unsigned int i = 2; i * i <= n; ++i) {
            if (n % i == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static_assert(is_prime(13), "13 should be a prime number");

    std::cout << "Compile-time computations and assertions completed successfully." << std::endl;
}

int main() {
     
    constexpr int fib(int n) {
        return (n <= 1) ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
    }

     
    template<int N>
    struct Fibonacci {};

    template<>
    struct Fibonacci<0> { static constexpr int value = 0; };

    template<>
    struct Fibonacci<1> { static constexpr int value = 1; };

    template<int N>
    struct Fibonacci {
        static constexpr int value = Fibonacci<N - 1>::value + Fibonacci<N - 2>::value;
    };

     
    static_assert(Fibonacci<8>::value == fib(8), "Compile-time and runtime Fibonacci values do not match");

     
    std::cout << "The 8th Fibonacci number is: " << fib(8) << '\n';
}

    struct ArrayHolder {
        static constexpr int arraySize = N;
        int data[arraySize];
    };

     
    unsigned long long testValue = 256ULL;

     
    static_assert(bitCount(testValue) == 9, "Bit count of 256 should be 9");

     
    ArrayHolder<bitCount(testValue)> holder;

     
    std::cout << "Array size: " << holder.arraySize << std::endl;
}

int main() {
     
    constexpr int numBits(unsigned long long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        int count = 0;
        while (n > 0) {
            ++count;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return count;
    }

     
    constexpr unsigned long long value = 256;  
    static_assert(numBits(value) <= 8, "Value exceeds 8 bits");  

     
    int arr[numBits(value)]{};

     
    std::cout << "Array size: " << sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]) << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    constexpr double pi_approx(double epsilon = 1e-10) {
        double pi = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
            double term = pow(-1, i) / (2 * i + 1);
            if (fabs(term) < epsilon) break;
            pi += term;
        }
        return pi * 4;
    }

     
    constexpr double pi = pi_approx();
    static_assert(pi > 3.14 && pi < 3.15, "Approximation of π is not accurate enough");

     
    int array_size = static_cast<int>(pi * 10);
    double* arr = new double[array_size];

     
    for (int i = 0; i < array_size; ++i) {
        arr[i] = static_cast<double>(i);
    }

     
    std::cout << "Array size: " << array_size << "\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < array_size; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << "\n";

     
    delete[] arr;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    constexpr double pi = 3.141592653589793;
    constexpr auto calculate_pi = [](double epsilon) {
        double sum = 0.0;
        for (int k = 0; ; ++k) {
            double term = 1.0 / (2 * k + 1);
            if (term < epsilon) break;
            sum += ((k % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1) * term;
        }
        return sum * 4;
    };

     
    constexpr double pi_epsilon = 1e-9;
    constexpr auto computed_pi = calculate_pi(pi_epsilon);

     
    static_assert(std::abs(computed_pi - pi) < pi_epsilon, "Calculated Pi does not match expected value");

     
    std::cout << "Computed PI: " << computed_pi << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at index: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 2);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }

        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";

        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(3);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 8;
    auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (it != vec.end() && *it == target) {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " found in the vector." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " not found in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

    std::vector<double> vec = {3.14, 2.718, 1.618, 0.577, 2.718};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    auto last = std::unique(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    vec.erase(last, vec.end());

     
    for (const auto& val : vec) {
        std::cout << val << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    double target = 1.618;
    auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (it != vec.end() && *it == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at index " << std::distance(vec.begin(), it) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(it, 1.414);

     
    for (const auto& val : vec) {
        std::cout << val << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(3);

     
    for (const auto& val : vec) {
        std::cout << val << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found in the vector." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3.5);
    
     
    vec.resize(7, 0.0);
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Element: " << *it << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Element at index " << i << ": " << vec[i] << std::endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

    std::vector<std::string> vec = {"apple", "banana", "cherry", "date"};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Index-based: " << vec[i] << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Iterator-based: " << *it << std::endl;

    std::cout << "After insert: ";
    for (const auto& str : vec) {
        std::cout << str << " ";

    std::cout << std::endl;

    std::cout << "After resize: ";
    for (const auto& str : vec) {
        std::cout << str << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end(), [](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
        return a.size() < b.size();
    });
    std::cout << "After sorting: ";
    for (const auto& str : vec) {
        std::cout << str << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::string target = "banana";
    auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target, [](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
        return a < b;
    });

    if (it != vec.end() && *it == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), it) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 4;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 1);
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    int arr[] = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    
     
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
    
     
    std::cout << "Array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::cout << "Array elements (iterator-based): ";
    for (auto it = std::begin(arr); it != std::end(arr); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::sort(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr));
    
     
    std::cout << "Sorted array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    int target = 7;
    if (std::binary_search(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr), target)) {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " found in the array." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " not found in the array." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    int insertValue = 4;
    auto it = std::begin(arr) + n / 2;  
    arr[n] = 0;  
    for (int i = n; i > static_cast<int>(it - arr); --i) {
        arr[i] = arr[i - 1];
    }
    arr[static_cast<int>(it - arr)] = insertValue;
    ++n;  
    
     
    std::cout << "Array after insertion: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    int eraseIndex = 2;  
    for (int i = eraseIndex; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
    }
    --n;  
    
     
    std::cout << "Array after erasing: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}

// END OF DOCUMENTATION
// BEGIN C++ PROGRAM
#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        int* data;
        Resource(int value = 0) : data(new int(value)) {
            std::cout << "Resource allocated with value " << *data << "\n";
        }
        ~Resource() {
            delete data;
            std::cout << "Resource deallocated\n";
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) {
            other.data = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete data;
                data = other.data;
                other.data = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource move assigned\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(new int(*other.data)) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete data;
                data = new int(*other.data);
                std::cout << "Resource copy assigned\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };
    {
        Resource res1(42);
        auto lambda = [res1]() {

#include <iostream>
int main() {
    int arr[] = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);
    std::cout << "Array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Array elements (iterator-based): ";
    for (auto it = std::begin(arr); it != std::end(arr); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    std::sort(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr));
    std::cout << "Sorted array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    int target = 7;
    if (std::binary_search(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr), target)) {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " found in the array." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " not found in the array." << std::endl;
    }
    int insertValue = 4;
    auto it = std::begin(arr) + n / 2;  
    arr[n] = 0;  
    for (int i = n; i > static_cast<int>(it - arr); --i) {
        arr[i] = arr[i - 1];
    }
    arr[static_cast<int>(it - arr)] = insertValue;
    ++n;  
    std::cout << "Array after insertion: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    int eraseIndex = 2;  
    for (int i = eraseIndex; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
    }
    --n;  
    std::cout << "Array after erasing: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    int target = 7;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at index " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 1);

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 3, 8, 4, 2};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 4;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 6);

     
    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 1);

     
    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {

    }

    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {

        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

        std::cout << *it << " ";

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 3, 8, 4, 2};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 4;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 6);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto printBitRepresentation = [](int num) {
        std::cout << "Binary representation of " << num << ": ";
        for (int i = 7; i >= 0; --i) {
            std::cout << ((num >> i) & 1);
        }
        std::cout << std::endl;
    };

    int number = 42;
    printBitRepresentation(number);

    return 0;
}

    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";

        std::cout << *it << " ";

    vec.resize(4);

        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 1);
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    
     
    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    int target = 3;
    auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    
    if (it != vec.end() && *it == target) {

    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;

    for (auto iter = vec.begin(); iter != vec.end(); ++iter) {
        std::cout << *iter << " ";

    std::cout << std::endl;

    vec.insert(insert_pos, 4);

    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 8, 1, 4};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto insertPos = vec.begin() + (vec.size() / 2);
    vec.insert(insertPos, 3);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto erasePos = vec.begin() + 3;
    vec.erase(erasePos);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto lowerBoundPos = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), 8);
    if (lowerBoundPos != vec.end() && *lowerBoundPos == 8) {
        std::cout << "Element 8 found at index: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lowerBoundPos) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element 8 not found" << std::endl;
    }
}

    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Index-based: " << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Iterator-based: " << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    
     
    int target = 4;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);

        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 6);
    
     
    vec.resize(7, 0);
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Modified Index-based: " << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Modified Iterator-based: " << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "After Erase Index-based: " << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "After Erase Iterator-based: " << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}

    std::array<std::variant<int, double, unsigned long>, 3> values = {a, b, c};

     
    for (auto& value : values) {
        if (std::holds_alternative<int>(value)) {
            int val = std::get<int>(value);
            std::cout << "Int: " << val << ", ";
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<double>(value)) {
            double val = std::get<double>(value);
            std::cout << "Double: " << val << ", ";
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<unsigned long>(value)) {
            unsigned long val = std::get<unsigned long>(value);
            std::cout << "Unsigned Long: " << val << ", ";
        }
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto& value : values) {
        if (std::holds_alternative<int>(value)) {
            int val = std::get<int>(value);
            double result1 = val + b;
            unsigned long result2 = val + c;
            std::cout << "Int: " << val << ", Double Result: " << result1 << ", Unsigned Long Result: " << result2 << std::endl;
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<double>(value)) {
            double val = std::get<double>(value);
            int result1 = static_cast<int>(val + a);
            unsigned long result2 = static_cast<unsigned long>(val + c);
            std::cout << "Double: " << val << ", Int Result: " << result1 << ", Unsigned Long Result: " << result2 << std::endl;
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<unsigned long>(value)) {
            unsigned long val = std::get<unsigned long>(value);
            int result1 = static_cast<int>(val + a);
            double result2 = val + b;
            std::cout << "Unsigned Long: " << val << ", Int Result: " << result1 << ", Double Result: " << result2 << std::endl;
        }
    }

     
    for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < values.size(); ++j) {
            if (std::holds_alternative<int>(values[i]) && std::holds_alternative<double>(values[j])) {
                int val1 = std::get<int>(values[i]);
                double val2 = std::get<double>(values[j]);
                std::cout << "Comparing: Int(" << val1 << ") with Double(" << val2 << ")" << std::endl;
                if (val1 == static_cast<int>(val2)) {
                    std::cout << "Int and Double are equal." << std::endl;
                } else {
                    std::cout << "Int and Double are not equal." << std::endl;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            std::cout << "Double: " << val << ", ";
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<unsigned long>(value)) {
            unsigned long val = std::get<unsigned long>(value);
            std::cout << "Unsigned Long: " << val << ", ";
        }
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int sum_int = a + static_cast<int>(b) + static_cast<int>(c);
    double sum_double = a + b + c;
    unsigned long sum_unsigned_long = static_cast<unsigned long>(a) + static_cast<unsigned long>(b) + c;

    std::cout << "Sum of int, double, and unsigned long: " 
              << (sum_int == static_cast<int>(sum_double) && sum_int == static_cast<int>(sum_unsigned_long) ? "Equal" : "Not Equal") << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Sum of int, double, and unsigned long: " 
              << (sum_int != static_cast<int>(sum_double) || sum_int != static_cast<int>(sum_unsigned_long) ? "Not Equal" : "Equal") << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    int a = 5;
    double b = 3.14;
    unsigned long c = 1234567890;

     
    std::array<std::variant<int, double, unsigned long>, 3> values = {a, b, c};

    for (const auto& value : values) {
        int result_int;
        double result_double;
        unsigned long result_ulong;

        if (std::holds_alternative<int>(value)) {
            result_int = std::get<int>(value);
            result_double = static_cast<double>(result_int);
            result_ulong = static_cast<unsigned long>(result_int);
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<double>(value)) {
            result_double = std::get<double>(value);
            result_int = static_cast<int>(result_double);
            result_ulong = static_cast<unsigned long>(result_double);
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<unsigned long>(value)) {
            result_ulong = std::get<unsigned long>(value);
            result_int = static_cast<int>(result_ulong);
            result_double = static_cast<double>(result_ulong);
        }

         
        std::cout << "Value: " << value.index() << ", int: " << result_int;
        std::cout << ", double: " << result_double << ", ulong: " << result_ulong << std::endl;

         
        if (result_int == static_cast<int>(result_double) && result_int == static_cast<int>(result_ulong)) {
            std::cout << "Result int matches double and ulong" << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "Result int does not match double or ulong" << std::endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

    double b = 3.2;
    unsigned long c = 10;
    auto result1 = a + b * c;  
    auto result2 = (a + b) * c;  
    std::cout << "result1: " << result1 << ", result2: " << result2 << std::endl;
    if (result1 == static_cast<double>(a + b * c)) {
        std::cout << "result1 equals a + b * c" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "result1 does not equal a + b * c" << std::endl;
    }
    if (result2 != static_cast<double>((a + b) * c)) {
        std::cout << "result2 does not equal (a + b) * c" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "result2 equals (a + b) * c" << std::endl;
    }
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    int a = 5;
    double b = 3.14;
    unsigned long c = 1234567890;

    auto resultAdd = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        std::cout << "Sum: " << a + b + static_cast<double>(c) << std::endl;
    };

    auto resultSubtract = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        std::cout << "Difference: " << a - b << std::endl;
    };

    auto resultMultiply = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        std::cout << "Product: " << a * static_cast<int>(b) * static_cast<long>(c) << std::endl;
    };

    auto resultDivide = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        if (b != 0) {
            std::cout << "Quotient: " << a / static_cast<int>(b) << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "Division by zero is not allowed." << std::endl;
        }
    };

    resultAdd();
    resultSubtract();
    resultMultiply();
    resultDivide();

    int array[] = {a, static_cast<int>(b), static_cast<int>(c)};

    for (const auto& val : array) {
        std::cout << "Value: " << val << std::endl;
    }

    if (a == static_cast<int>(b)) {
        std::cout << "Comparison a == b: true" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparison a == b: false" << std::endl;
    }

    if (a != c) {
        std::cout << "Comparison a != c: true" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparison a != c: false" << std::endl;
    }
}

        std::cout << "Comparison a == b: true" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparison a == b: false" << std::endl;

    int a = 10;
    double b = 20.5;
    unsigned long c = 30UL;

     
    std::tuple<int, double, unsigned long> values[] = {std::make_tuple(a, b, c)};

     
    for (const auto& val : values) {
        int ia;
        double db;
        unsigned long ul;
        std::tie(ia, db, ul) = val;

         
        double sumDouble = db + static_cast<double>(ia);
        double productDouble = db * static_cast<double>(ia);
        int sumInt = ia + static_cast<int>(ul);
        int differenceInt = ia - static_cast<int>(ul);

         
        if (sumDouble == productDouble) {
            std::cout << "Sum of double and casted int is equal to product of double and casted int: " << sumDouble << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "Sum of double and casted int is not equal to product of double and casted int: " << sumDouble << ", " << productDouble << std::endl;
        }

        if (sumInt != differenceInt) {
            std::cout << "Sum of int and casted unsigned long is not equal to difference of int and casted unsigned long: " << sumInt << ", " << differenceInt << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "Sum of int and casted unsigned long is equal to difference of int and casted unsigned long: " << sumInt << std::endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct ResourceGuard {
        int* resource;
        ResourceGuard(int value = 0) : resource(new int(value)) {}
        ~ResourceGuard() { delete resource; }
         
        ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept : resource(other.resource) {
            other.resource = nullptr;
        }
        ResourceGuard& operator=(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete resource;
                resource = other.resource;
                other.resource = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
         
        ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard& other) : resource(new int(*other.resource)) {}
        ResourceGuard& operator=(const ResourceGuard& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete resource;
                resource = new int(*other.resource);
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    ResourceGuard guard1(42);

     
    auto lambda = [guard = std::move(guard1)]() {
        std::cout << "Resource value: " << *guard.resource << std::endl;
    };

    lambda();

     
    if (guard1.resource == nullptr) {
        std::cout << "Guard1 has been moved and its resource is no longer valid." << std::endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    struct ResourceGuard {
        std::string resource;
        explicit ResourceGuard(const std::string& res) : resource(res) {
            std::cout << "Resource acquired: " << resource << std::endl;
        }
        ~ResourceGuard() {
            std::cout << "Resource released: " << resource << std::endl;
        }
        ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept : resource(std::move(other.resource)) {
            std::cout << "Resource moved: " << resource << std::endl;
        }
        ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard& other) noexcept : resource(other.resource) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied: " << resource << std::endl;
        }
    };
    ResourceGuard res1("Local File");
    {
        auto useResource = [res = std::move(res1)]() mutable {
            std::cout << "Using resource: " << res.resource << std::endl;
        };
        useResource();
    }  
    std::cout << "Main function ends." << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct ResourceGuard {
        int* ptr;
        ResourceGuard(int value = 0) : ptr(new int(value)) {}
        ~ResourceGuard() { delete ptr; }
         
        ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) {}
         
        ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) { other.ptr = nullptr; }
         
        ResourceGuard& operator=(const ResourceGuard& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = new int(*other.ptr);
            }
            return *this;
        }
         
        ResourceGuard& operator=(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        ResourceGuard rg(i + 1);
        std::cout << "ResourceGuard instance created with value: " << *rg.ptr << std::endl;
    }

     
    ResourceGuard mainGuard(42);
    auto lambda = [](ResourceGuard rg) {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << *rg.ptr << std::endl;
    };
    lambda(mainGuard);  

    return 0;
}

int main() {
     
    struct ResourceGuard {
        int* ptr;
        ResourceGuard(int value) : ptr(new int(value)) {}
        ~ResourceGuard() { delete ptr; }
         
        ResourceGuard(const ResourceGuard& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) {}
         
        ResourceGuard(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) { other.ptr = nullptr; }
         
        ResourceGuard& operator=(const ResourceGuard& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = new int(*other.ptr);
            }
            return *this;
        }
         
        ResourceGuard& operator=(ResourceGuard&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    ResourceGuard rg1(42);
    {
        ResourceGuard rg2 = std::move(rg1);  
    }

     
    auto lambda = [](ResourceGuard rg) {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << *rg.ptr << std::endl;
    };

    ResourceGuard rg3(100);
    lambda(std::move(rg3));  
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        int* ptr;
        Resource() : ptr(new int(0)) { std::cout << "Resource allocated\n"; }
        ~Resource() { delete ptr; std::cout << "Resource deallocated\n"; }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource move assigned\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    {
        Resource res;
         
        auto lambda = [res]() mutable { std::cout << "Lambda captured resource: " << *res.ptr << "\n"; };
        lambda();
    }

     
    int value = 42;
    std::cout << "Binary representation of 42 is: ";
    for (int i = sizeof(value) * 8 - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        std::cout << ((value >> i) & 1);
    }
    std::cout << "\n";
}

    constexpr int fib(int n) {
        return (n <= 1) ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
    }

     
    template <int N>
    struct Fibonacci {
        static constexpr int value = fib(N);
    };

     
    static_assert(Fibonacci<10>::value == 55, "Fibonacci number at index 10 is incorrect");

     
    constexpr int fibArraySize = 10;
    std::array<int, Fibonacci<fibArraySize>::value> fibArray;

     
    std::cout << "Fibonacci number at index 10 (compile-time) is: " << Fibonacci<10>::value << "\n";
    std::cout << "Array size initialized with Fibonacci number at index 10: " << fibArray.size() << "\n";
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    constexpr int factorial(int n) {
        return (n <= 1) ? 1 : n * factorial(n - 1);
    }

     
    template <int N>
    struct Factorial {
        static constexpr int value = N * Factorial<N - 1>::value;
    };

    template <>
    struct Factorial<0> {
        static constexpr int value = 1;
    };

     
    auto fibonacci = [](int n) -> int {
        if (n <= 1) return n;
        int a = 0, b = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            int temp = a + b;
            a = b;
            b = temp;
        }
        return b;
    };

     
    static_assert(factorial(5) == 120, "Factorial of 5 should be 120");
    static_assert(Factorial<5>::value == 120, "Factorial of 5 should be 120");
    static_assert(fibonacci(10) == 55, "Fibonacci number at position 10 should be 55");

     
    std::cout << "Factorial of 5: " << factorial(5) << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Factorial<5>::value: " << Factorial<5>::value << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Fibonacci number at position 10: " << fibonacci(10) << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    std::vector<unsigned int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    unsigned int target = 7;
    auto lowerBoundIt = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lowerBoundIt != vec.end() && *lowerBoundIt == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at index: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lowerBoundIt) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found." << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(3);

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<double> vec = {3.1, 2.7, 4.5, 1.9, 2.0};

     
    std::cout << "Vector before modifications: ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    std::cout << "Sorted vector: ";
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    double searchValue = 2.7;
    auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), searchValue);
    if (it != vec.end() && *it == searchValue) {
        std::cout << "Found " << searchValue << " in the vector." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Did not find " << searchValue << " in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

     
    double newValue = 3.2;
    vec.insert(std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), newValue), newValue);

     
    std::cout << "Vector after insertion: ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    double eraseValue = 2.7;
    auto eraseIt = std::find(vec.begin(), vec.end(), eraseValue);
    if (eraseIt != vec.end()) {
        vec.erase(eraseIt);
    }

     
    std::cout << "Vector after erasing: ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    size_t newSize = 8;
    vec.resize(newSize, 0.0);  

     
    std::cout << "Vector after resizing: ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    std::string target = "banana";
    auto it = std::find(words.begin(), words.end(), target);
    if (it != words.end()) {
        std::cout << "Found: " << *it << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Not found: " << target << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.insert(words.begin(), "fig");

     
    words.resize(words.size() / 2);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Resized and Index-based: " << words[i] << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

    std::vector<std::string> words = {"apple", "banana", "cherry", "date"};

        std::cout << "Index-based: " << words[i] << std::endl;

        std::cout << "Iterator-based: " << *it << std::endl;

    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << "After insert: " << word << std::endl;
    }

     
    std::sort(words.begin(), words.end());

     
    std::string target = "banana";
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(words.begin(), words.end(), target);
    if (lb != words.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found: " << target << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Not found: " << target << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.erase(words.begin() + 2);

        std::cout << target << " not found." << std::endl;

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    int arr[] = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);

     
    std::cout << "Array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::cout << "Array elements: ";
    for (auto it = std::begin(arr); it != std::end(arr); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr));

     
    std::cout << "Sorted array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    if (std::binary_search(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr), target)) {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " found in the array." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " not found in the array." << std::endl;
    }

     
    int newElement = 4;
    arr[n] = newElement;
    ++n;

     
    std::sort(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr));

     
    std::cout << "Array elements after insertion: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int eraseIndex = 2;
    for (int i = eraseIndex; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        arr[i] = arr[i + 1];
    }
    --n;

     
    std::cout << "Array elements after erasing index " << eraseIndex << ": ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (const auto& item : vec) {
        std::cout << item << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    if (std::binary_search(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target)) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " in the vector." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Did not find " << target << " in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.insert(vec.end(), 8);

     
    for (const auto& item : vec) {
        std::cout << item << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    if (!vec.empty()) {
        vec.erase(vec.begin() + 2);  
    }

     
    for (const auto& item : vec) {
        std::cout << item << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(3);

     
    for (const auto& item : vec) {
        std::cout << item << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

int main() {
    int a = 5, b = 3, c = 4, d = 2;
    bool result = (a != b) || (c != d);
    int x = 1, y = 1, z = 2, w = 2;
    bool result2 = (x == y) && (z == w);
    
     
    struct Comparison {
        int value1, value2;
        bool evaluate() {
            return value1 != value2;
        }
    };
    
    Comparison comp1 = {a, b};
    Comparison comp2 = {c, d};
    Comparison comp3 = {x, y};
    Comparison comp4 = {z, w};
    
    bool finalResult1 = comp1.evaluate() || comp2.evaluate();
    bool finalResult2 = comp3.evaluate() && comp4.evaluate();
    
    std::cout << "finalResult1: " << finalResult1 << std::endl;
    std::cout << "finalResult2: " << finalResult2 << std::endl;
}

        std::cout << "Product is correct: " << product << std::endl;

    double b = 3.14;
    unsigned long c = 1234567890;

     
    auto result1 = a + static_cast<int>(b);
    auto result2 = b * static_cast<double>(c);
    auto result3 = c - static_cast<unsigned long>(a);

    std::cout << "Result of int + double: " << result1 << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Result of double * unsigned long: " << result2 << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Result of unsigned long - int: " << result3 << std::endl;

     
    auto values = {a, b, c};
    for (const auto& val : values) {
        if (val == static_cast<int>(val)) {
            std::cout << "Value matches int: " << val << std::endl;
        } else if (val != static_cast<double>(val)) {
            std::cout << "Value does not match double: " << val << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "Value does not match unsigned long: " << val << std::endl;
        }
    }
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    int a = 5;
    double b = 3.2;
    unsigned long c = 10;

     
    auto values = {a, static_cast<double>(b), static_cast<unsigned long>(c)};

     
    for (const auto& val : values) {
        std::cout << "Value: " << val;
        if (&val == &values[0]) {
            std::cout << ", Next Value: " << values[1];
            double sum = val + static_cast<double>(values[1]);
            std::cout << ", Sum (int + double): " << sum;
        } else if (&val == &values[1]) {
            std::cout << ", Previous Value: " << values[0];
            unsigned long product = val * static_cast<unsigned long>(values[0]);
            std::cout << ", Product (double * int): " << product;
        } else if (&val == &values[2]) {
            std::cout << ", Previous Value: " << values[1];
            double division = val / static_cast<double>(values[1]);
            std::cout << ", Division (unsigned long / double): " << division;
        }
        std::cout << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < values.size(); ++j) {
            if (i != j) {
                std::cout << "Comparing " << values[i] << " and " << values[j] << ": ";
                if (values[i] == static_cast<decltype(values[i])>(values[j])) {
                    std::cout << "Equal";
                } else {
                    std::cout << "Not Equal";
                }
                std::cout << std::endl;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

            int val = std::get<int>(value);
            std::cout << "int: " << val << "\n";
        } else if (std::holds_alternative<double>(value)) {

            std::cout << "double: " << val << "\n";

            unsigned long val = std::get<unsigned long>(value);
            std::cout << "unsigned long: " << val << "\n";
        }
    }

     
    auto sum1 = a + b;
    auto sum2 = c + b;
    auto product = a * static_cast<int>(b);
    auto quotient = static_cast<double>(c) / a;

    std::cout << "Arithmetic operations:\n";
    std::cout << "sum1 (int + double): " << sum1 << "\n";
    std::cout << "sum2 (unsigned long + double): " << sum2 << "\n";
    std::cout << "product (int * double): " << product << "\n";
    std::cout << "quotient (unsigned long / int): " << quotient << "\n";

int main() {
    int a = 5;
    double b = 3.2;
    unsigned long c = 10;
    auto result1 = a + b * c;  
    auto result2 = static_cast<double>(a) + b * c;  
    std::cout << "result1 (implicit promotion): " << result1 << "\n";
    std::cout << "result2 (explicit conversion): " << result2 << "\n";
    if (result1 == static_cast<double>(a) + b * c) {
        std::cout << "result1 is equal to result2\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "result1 is not equal to result2\n";
    }
    if (result1 != result2) {
        std::cout << "result1 is not equal to result2\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "result1 is equal to result2\n";
    }
    int a_new = 10;
    double b_new = 20.5;
    unsigned long c_new = 30L;
    auto result1_new = a_new + static_cast<double>(c_new);
    auto result2_new = static_cast<int>(b_new) * c_new;
    auto result3_new = (a_new + b_new) - static_cast<unsigned long>(c_new);
    std::cout << "result1: " << result1_new << std::endl;
    std::cout << "result2: " << result2_new << std::endl;
    std::cout << "result3: " << result3_new << std::endl;
    int arr[] = {a_new, static_cast<int>(b_new), static_cast<int>(c_new)};
    for (auto val : arr) {
        std::cout << "Value: " << val << std::endl;
    }
    if (result1_new == a_new + b_new && result2_new != c_new * static_cast<unsigned long>(a_new)) {
        std::cout << "Comparisons are correct." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Comparisons failed." << std::endl;
    }
    int x = 5;
    int y = 3;
    int andResult = x & y;
    int orResult = x | y;
    int xorResult = x ^ y;
    int leftShift = x << 1;
    int rightShift = x >> 1;
    std::cout << "andResult: " << andResult << std::endl;
    std::cout << "orResult: " << orResult << std::endl;
    std::cout << "xorResult: " << xorResult << std::endl;
    std::cout << "leftShift: " << leftShift << std::endl;
    std::cout << "rightShift: " << rightShift << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        int* ptr;
        Resource() : ptr(new int(0)) { std::cout << "Resource allocated\n"; }
        ~Resource() { 
            delete ptr;
            std::cout << "Resource deallocated\n"; 
        }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n";
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource move assigned\n";
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    {
        Resource res1;
        std::cout << "res1 ptr: " << res1.ptr << "\n";
    }
    std::cout << "Scope ended for res1\n";

     
    {
        Resource res2;
        auto lambda = [res2]() { 
            std::cout << "Lambda captured resource with ptr: " << res2.ptr << "\n";
        };
        lambda();  
    }
    std::cout << "Scope ended for res2\n";
}

int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        int* ptr;
        Resource() : ptr(new int(0)) { std::cout << "Resource allocated." << std::endl; }
        ~Resource() { 
            delete ptr; 
            std::cout << "Resource deallocated." << std::endl; 
        }
         
        Resource(const Resource& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied." << std::endl;
        }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved." << std::endl;
        }
         
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                *ptr = *other.ptr;
                std::cout << "Resource assigned." << std::endl;
            }
            return *this;
        }
         
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource moved assigned." << std::endl;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    {
        Resource res1;
        std::cout << "Using resource in scope." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Resource res2;
    auto useResource = [res2]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, accessing resource: " << *res2.ptr << std::endl;
    };
    useResource();
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        int* ptr;
        Resource() : ptr(new int(0)) { std::cout << "Resource allocated at " << ptr << "\n"; }
        ~Resource() { 
            delete ptr;
            std::cout << "Resource deallocated\n"; 
        }
         
        Resource(const Resource& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) { 
            std::cout << "Resource copied from " << other.ptr << "\n"; 
        }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) { 
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n"; 
        }
         
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                *ptr = *other.ptr;
                std::cout << "Resource copy assigned from " << other.ptr << "\n"; 
            }
            return *this;
        }
         
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource move assigned\n"; 
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    {
        Resource res1;
        {
            Resource res2 = res1;  
            std::cout << "Inside nested block, resource 2 exists\n";
        }  
        std::cout << "Back to outer block, resource 2 is destroyed\n";
    }

     
    Resource res3;
    auto lambda = [res3]() {
        std::cout << "Lambda captures and uses the moved-from resource: ";
        if (res3.ptr != nullptr) {
            std::cout << *res3.ptr << "\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "null\n";
        }
    };
    lambda();  

    return 0;
}

// BEGIN C++ PROGRAM
#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        std::string data;
        Resource(const std::string& str) : data(str) {
            std::cout << "Resource acquired: " << data << std::endl;
        }
        ~Resource() {
            std::cout << "Resource destroyed: " << data << std::endl;
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(std::move(other.data)) {
            std::cout << "Resource moved: " << data << std::endl;
        }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(other.data) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied: " << data << std::endl;
        }
    };
    Resource res("local resource");
    auto lambda = [res_copy = res]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, accessing copied resource: " << res_copy.data << std::endl;
    };
    lambda();
}
// END OF DOCUMENTATION
// BEGIN C++ PROGRAM
#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        int* ptr;
        Resource() : ptr(new int(0)) { std::cout << "Resource allocated at " << ptr << "\n"; }
        ~Resource() { 
            delete ptr;
            std::cout << "Resource deallocated\n"; 
        }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) { 
            std::cout << "Resource copied from " << other.ptr << "\n"; 
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) { 
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n"; 
        }
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                *ptr = *other.ptr;
                std::cout << "Resource copy assigned from " << other.ptr << "\n"; 
            }
            return *this;
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete ptr;
                ptr = other.ptr;
                other.ptr = nullptr;
                std::cout << "Resource move assigned\n"; 
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };
    {
        Resource res1;
        {
            Resource res2 = res1;  
            std::cout << "Inside nested block, resource 2 exists\n";
        }  
        std::cout << "Back to outer block, resource 2 is destroyed\n";
    }
    Resource res3;
    auto lambda = [res3]() {
        std::cout << "Lambda captures and uses the moved-from resource: ";
        if (res3.ptr != nullptr) {
            std::cout << *res3.ptr << "\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "null\n";
        }
    };
    lambda();  
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        int* data;
        Resource() : data(new int[10]) {}
        ~Resource() { delete[] data; }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(new int[10]) {
            std::copy(other.data, other.data + 10, data);
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) {
            other.data = nullptr;
        }
         
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete[] data;
                data = other.data;
                other.data = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    Resource res1;

     
    auto useResource = [res = std::move(res1)](int x) {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda: " << *res.data << "\n";
    };

     
    useResource(42);
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct RAIIResource {
        int value;
        RAIIResource(int val = 0) : value(val) {}
        ~RAIIResource() { std::cout << "Destroying resource with value: " << value << "\n"; }
        RAIIResource(const RAIIResource& other) : value(other.value) {
            std::cout << "Copy constructing resource with value: " << value << "\n";
        }
        RAIIResource(RAIIResource&& other) noexcept : value(other.value) {
            std::cout << "Move constructing resource with value: " << value << "\n";
            other.value = 0;  
        }
        RAIIResource& operator=(const RAIIResource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                std::cout << "Copy assigning resource from value: " << other.value << "\n";
                value = other.value;
            }
            return *this;
        }
        RAIIResource& operator=(RAIIResource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                std::cout << "Move assigning resource to value: " << other.value << "\n";
                value = other.value;
                other.value = 0;  
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };

     
    RAIIResource resource1(42);

     
    auto lambda = [resource = std::move(resource1)]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << resource.value << "\n";
    };

     
    lambda();

    constexpr double goldenRatio(int n) {
        if (n == 0) return 1.0;
        if (n == 1) return 2.0 / (1.0 + 1.0);
        return 2.0 / (goldenRatio(n - 1) + 1.0);
    }

     
    constexpr double phi = goldenRatio(10);

     
    static_assert(phi == (1.0 + std::sqrt(5)) / 2.0, "Golden ratio does not match expected value");

     
    std::cout << "The golden ratio is approximately: " << phi << std::endl;
}

    double fib_array[fib_array_size];

     
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < fib_array_size; ++i) {
        fib_array[i] = golden_ratio * i;
    }

     
    std::cout << "First few Fibonacci numbers initialized with Golden Ratio:" << std::endl;
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < 5 && i < fib_array_size; ++i) {
        std::cout << fib_array[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

#include <iostream>
int main() {
    struct Resource {
        int* data;
        Resource(int value = 0) : data(new int(value)) {}
        ~Resource() { delete data; }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(new int(*other.data)) {}
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) { other.data = nullptr; }
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                *data = *other.data;
            }
            return *this;
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete data;
                data = other.data;
                other.data = nullptr;
            }
            return *this;
        }
    };
    Resource res(42);
    auto lambda = [res]() {
        std::cout << "Inside lambda, accessing resource data: " << *(res.data) << std::endl;
    };
    lambda();
}
