[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    constexpr unsigned long long fib(unsigned int n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        if (n == 1) return 1;
        unsigned long long a = 0, b = 1;
        for (unsigned int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            unsigned long long next = a + b;
            a = b;
            b = next;
        }
        return b;
    }

     
    constexpr unsigned int fibIndex = 10;  
    static_assert(fibIndex < 94, "Fibonacci number exceeds maximum representable integer size");

     
    constexpr unsigned long long fibValue = fib(fibIndex);
    unsigned long long fibArray[fibValue];

     
    std::cout << "Fibonacci number at index " << fibIndex << " is: " << fibValue << std::endl;
}

    constexpr int fib(int n) {
        return (n <= 1) ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
    }

     
    const int fibNumber = 9;  
    static_assert(fibNumber >= 0 && fibNumber < 20, "Fibonacci number index out of bounds");

    int fibArray[fib(fibNumber)];

     
    static_assert(sizeof(fibArray) == fib(fibNumber), "Size mismatch between array and computed Fibonacci number");

     
    std::cout << "The size of the Fibonacci array is: " << sizeof(fibArray) / sizeof(fibArray[0]) << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 3, 8, 4, 2};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 4;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 6);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

    }
    
     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {

    std::vector<std::string> words = {"apple", "banana", "cherry", "date", "elderberry"};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Index-based: " << words[i] << std::endl;
    }

     
    std::sort(words.begin(), words.end());

     
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << "Iterator-based: " << word << std::endl;
    }

     
    auto it = std::lower_bound(words.begin(), words.end(), "banana");
    if (it != words.end() && *it == "banana") {
        std::cout << "Found 'banana' in the vector." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Did not find 'banana' in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.insert(words.begin() + 2, "fig");

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Index-based after insert: " << words[i] << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.resize(3);

     
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << "Iterator-based after resize: " << word << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    std::vector<std::string> words = {"apple", "banana", "cherry", "date"};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Index-based: " << words[i] << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (auto it = words.begin(); it != words.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Iterator-based: " << *it << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.insert(words.begin(), "grape");

     
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << "After insertion: " << word << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.resize(3);

     
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << "After resize: " << word << std::endl;
    }

     
    std::sort(words.begin(), words.end(), [](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
        return a.length() < b.length();
    });

     
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << "Sorted by length: " << word << std::endl;
    }

     
    auto it = std::lower_bound(words.begin(), words.end(), "banana", [](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
        return a < b;
    });

    if (it != words.end() && *it == "banana") {
        std::cout << "Found 'banana' at position: " << it - words.begin() << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "'banana' not found" << std::endl;
    }
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    std::vector<std::string> words = {"apple", "banana", "cherry", "date", "elderberry"};

     
    std::cout << "Initial vector: ";
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << word << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(words.begin(), words.end());

     
    std::cout << "Sorted vector: ";
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << word << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::string target = "cherry";
    auto it = std::lower_bound(words.begin(), words.end(), target);
    if (it != words.end() && *it == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position: " << std::distance(words.begin(), it) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found." << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.insert(std::lower_bound(words.begin(), words.end(), "fig"), "fig");

     
    std::cout << "Vector after insertion: ";
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << word << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    words.erase(std::remove(words.begin(), words.end(), "banana"), words.end());

     
    std::cout << "Vector after erasing 'banana': ";
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << word << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    words.resize(3);

     
    std::cout << "Vector after resizing: ";
    for (const auto& word : words) {
        std::cout << word << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    int arr[] = {5, 2, 8, 1, 3};
    
     
    std::array<int, 5> myArray = {5, 2, 8, 1, 3};
    
     
    std::cout << "Index-based iteration: ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < myArray.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << myArray[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::cout << "Iterator-based iteration: ";
    for (auto it = myArray.begin(); it != myArray.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::sort(myArray.begin(), myArray.end());
    
     
    std::cout << "Sorted array: ";
    for (const auto& elem : myArray) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    int target = 8;
    auto lowerBoundIt = std::lower_bound(myArray.begin(), myArray.end(), target);
    if (lowerBoundIt != myArray.end() && *lowerBoundIt == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position: " << std::distance(myArray.begin(), lowerBoundIt) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found in the array." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    myArray.insert(std::lower_bound(myArray.begin(), myArray.end(), 7), 7);
    std::cout << "Array after inserting 7: ";
    for (const auto& elem : myArray) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    myArray.erase(std::remove(myArray.begin(), myArray.end(), 2), myArray.end());
    std::cout << "Array after erasing 2: ";
    for (const auto& elem : myArray) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    myArray.resize(4);
    std::cout << "Resized array to size 4: ";
    for (const auto& elem : myArray) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    int target = 5;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);
    
     
    vec.resize(8, 0);
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}

    std::cout << "Vector after inserting 3: ";
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {

        int* data;
        Resource(int value = 0) : data(new int(value)) {}
        ~Resource() { delete data; }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(new int(*other.data)) {}
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) { other.data = nullptr; }
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                *data = *other.data;
            }
            return *this;
        }
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {

                data = other.data;
                other.data = nullptr;

            return *this;

    unsigned long c = 3;

        std::cout << val << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    double sum = a + b + c;
    std::cout << "Sum: " << sum << std::endl;

     
    if (sum == static_cast<int>(a) + b + static_cast<double>(c)) {
        std::cout << "Equal" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Not Equal" << std::endl;
    }

    std::cout << "Promoted Result (int + double): " << promotedResult << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    unsigned int a = 10;
    double b = 3.5;
    unsigned long c = 20UL;

     
    auto result1 = a + static_cast<int>(b);
    auto result2 = c - static_cast<unsigned int>(b);
    auto result3 = b * static_cast<double>(c);
    auto result4 = c / static_cast<unsigned long>(a);

     
    std::array<std::variant<unsigned int, double, unsigned long>, 3> mixedValues = {a, b, c};
    for (const auto& value : mixedValues) {
         
        if (value.index() == 0) {
            std::cout << "Comparing unsigned int: " << std::get<unsigned int>(value) << "\n";
        } else if (value.index() == 1) {
            std::cout << "Comparing double: " << std::get<double>(value) << "\n";
        } else if (value.index() == 2) {
            std::cout << "Comparing unsigned long: " << std::get<unsigned long>(value) << "\n";
        }
    }

     
    std::cout << "Result of a + static_cast<int>(b): " << result1 << "\n";
    std::cout << "Result of c - static_cast<unsigned int>(b): " << result2 << "\n";
    std::cout << "Result of b * static_cast<double>(c): " << result3 << "\n";
    std::cout << "Result of c / static_cast<unsigned long>(a): " << result4 << "\n";
}

    if (arr[0] != static_cast<int>(b) || arr[1] != static_cast<double>(c) || arr[2] != 2 * c) {
        std::cout << "The array values are not as expected." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The array values are equal to the expected values." << std::endl;
    }
}

    double b = 3.5;
    unsigned long c = 20UL;

     
    auto sum = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        std::cout << "Initial values: " << a << ", " << b << ", " << c << "\n";
        double result1 = a + b * static_cast<double>(c);
        int result2 = a + static_cast<int>(b) / c;
        std::cout << "Sum (a + b * c): " << result1 << "\n";
        std::cout << "Sum (a + b / c): " << result2 << "\n";
    };

    sum();

     
    auto printArray = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        std::array<std::variant<int, double, unsigned long>, 3> arr = {a, b, c};
        for (const auto& val : arr) {
            if (std::holds_alternative<int>(val)) {
                std::cout << "Int value: " << std::get<int>(val) << "\n";
            } else if (std::holds_alternative<double>(val)) {
                std::cout << "Double value: " << std::get<double>(val) << "\n";
            } else if (std::holds_alternative<unsigned long>(val)) {
                std::cout << "Unsigned long value: " << std::get<unsigned long>(val) << "\n";
            }
        }
    };

    printArray();

     
    auto compareValues = [a, b, c]() -> void {
        int promotedInt = a + static_cast<int>(b);
        std::cout << "Comparing: " << (promotedInt == static_cast<double>(c)) << "\n";
        std::cout << "Comparing: " << (a != static_cast<unsigned long>(b)) << "\n";
    };

    compareValues();
}

    unsigned long c = 1234567890;

        std::cout << "Implicit promotion results in equality.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Implicit promotion does not result in equality.\n";
    }

    if (result2 == result1) {
        std::cout << "Explicit and implicit promotions are equal.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Explicit and implicit promotions are not equal.\n";
    }

     
    int arr[] = {a, static_cast<int>(b), static_cast<int>(c)};
    for (auto val : arr) {
        std::cout << "Array value: " << val << "\n";

    struct Resource {

        Resource() : ptr(new int(0)) { std::cout << "Resource acquired\n"; }
        ~Resource() { 
            delete ptr;
            std::cout << "Resource released\n"; 
        }
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n";
        }
         
        Resource(const Resource& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied\n";
        }
    };

        Resource res1;
         
        auto lambda = [res1]() mutable {
            std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << *res1.ptr << "\n";
        };
        lambda();
    }
}

        ~Resource() { 
            delete ptr;
            std::cout << "Resource released\n"; 
        }
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : ptr(other.ptr) {
            other.ptr = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved\n";
        }
        Resource(const Resource& other) : ptr(new int(*other.ptr)) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied\n";
        }
    };
    {
        Resource res1;
        auto lambda = [res1]() mutable {
            std::cout << "Inside lambda, resource value: " << *res1.ptr << "\n";
        };
        lambda();
    }
}

            other.data = nullptr;

    };

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    struct Resource {
        int* data;
        
        Resource(int value = 0) : data(new int(value)) {
            std::cout << "Resource constructed with value " << *data << std::endl;
        }
        
        ~Resource() {
            delete data;
            std::cout << "Resource destroyed" << std::endl;
        }
        
         
        Resource(const Resource& other) : data(new int(*other.data)) {
            std::cout << "Resource copied" << std::endl;
        }
        
         
        Resource(Resource&& other) noexcept : data(other.data) {
            other.data = nullptr;
            std::cout << "Resource moved" << std::endl;
        }
        
         
        Resource& operator=(const Resource& other) {
            if (this != &other) {
                *data = *other.data;
            }
            std::cout << "Resource copy assigned" << std::endl;
            return *this;
        }
        
         
        Resource& operator=(Resource&& other) noexcept {
            if (this != &other) {
                delete data;
                data = other.data;
                other.data = nullptr;
            }
            std::cout << "Resource move assigned" << std::endl;
            return *this;
        }
    };
    
     
    {
        Resource res(42);
        
        auto lambda = [res]() mutable {
            std::cout << "Lambda captured resource with value " << *res.data << std::endl;
        };
        
        lambda();  
    }  
}

        return n == 0 ? 1 : n * factorial(n - 1);
    }

    static_assert(factorial(5) == 120, "Factorial of 5 should be 120");

    constexpr unsigned long long fibonacci(unsigned int n) {
        return n <= 1 ? n : fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2);
    }

    static_assert(fibonacci(10) == 55, "Fibonacci of 10 should be 55");

    unsigned int size = 5;
    std::array<int, factorial(size)> arr;
    std::cout << "Size of array: " << arr.size() << "\n";

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    const int N = 5;
    auto factorial = [](int n) -> int {
        return (n <= 1) ? 1 : n * factorial(n - 1);
    };
    
     
    template <unsigned long long value>
    struct Factorial {};

    template <>
    struct Factorial<0> { static const unsigned long long value = 1; };

    template <int n>
    struct Fibonacci {};

    template <>
    struct Fibonacci<0> { static constexpr int value = 0; };

    template <>
    struct Fibonacci<1> { static constexpr int value = 1; };

    template <int n>
    struct Fibonacci {
        static const int value = Fibonacci<n - 1>::value + Fibonacci<n - 2>::value;
    };

     
    static_assert(factorial(N) == Factorial<5>::value, "Factorial computation failed");
    static_assert(Fibonacci<N>::value == 5, "Fibonacci computation failed");

     
    std::cout << "Factorial of " << N << " is: " << factorial(N) << "\n";
    std::cout << "Fibonacci number at position " << N << " is: " << Fibonacci<N>::value << "\n";
}

int main() {
     
    constexpr int fibonacci(int n) {
        return (n <= 1) ? n : fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2);
    }

     
    static_assert(fibonacci(8) == 21, "Fibonacci number at index 8 is not correct");
    int fibArray[fibonacci(8)];

     
    std::cout << "Fibonacci sequence: ";
    for (int i = 0; i <= 8; ++i) {
        std::cout << fibonacci(i) << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

        return (n <= 1) ? 1 : (n * factorial(n - 1));
    }

    struct FactorialStruct {
        static constexpr int value = factorial(N);
    };

    constexpr int bitCount(unsigned long long n) {
        return (n == 0) ? 1 : 1 + bitCount(n >> 1);
    }

     
    template<int N>
    struct isPowerOfTwo {
        static_assert(N > 0 && (N & (N - 1)) == 0, "Value must be a positive power of two");
    };

     
    constexpr unsigned long long testValue = 64;  
    static_assert(bitCount(testValue) == 7, "bitCount computation failed or incorrect value used");

     
    isPowerOfTwo<testValue> verify;

     
    std::cout << "The number of bits needed to represent " << testValue << " is " << bitCount(testValue) << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    constexpr unsigned long long fib(unsigned int n) {
        return (n <= 1) ? n : fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
    }

     
    constexpr unsigned int fibIndex = 10;  
    static_assert(fibIndex < 94, "Fibonacci number too large for type unsigned long long");
    
     
    constexpr unsigned long long fibNum = fib(fibIndex);
    static_assert(fibNum <= std::numeric_limits<unsigned long long>::max(), "Fibonacci number too large for type unsigned long long");
    
     
    unsigned long long fibArray[fibIndex];

     
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < fibIndex; ++i) {
        fibArray[i] = fib(i);
    }

     
    std::cout << "Fibonacci sequence up to index " << fibIndex << ":" << std::endl;
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < fibIndex; ++i) {
        std::cout << "fib(" << i << ") = " << fibArray[i] << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at index: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(4);

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    std::vector<double> numbers = {5.2, 3.1, 8.7, 1.9, 4.6};

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements: ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < numbers.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << numbers[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements (iterator): ";
    for (auto it = numbers.begin(); it != numbers.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(numbers.begin(), numbers.end());

     
    std::cout << "Sorted vector elements: ";
    for (const auto& num : numbers) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    double searchValue = 4.6;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(numbers.begin(), numbers.end(), searchValue);
    if (lb != numbers.end() && *lb == searchValue) {
        std::cout << "Found " << searchValue << " in the vector." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Did not find " << searchValue << " in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

     
    numbers.insert(numbers.begin() + 2, 2.5);

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements after insertion: ";
    for (const auto& num : numbers) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    numbers.erase(numbers.begin() + 3);

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements after erasing: ";
    for (const auto& num : numbers) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    numbers.resize(4);

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements after resizing: ";
    for (const auto& num : numbers) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

    std::vector<std::string> words = {"apple", "banana", "cherry", "date"};

     
    words.push_back("elderberry");

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Index-based: " << words[i] << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (auto it = words.begin(); it != words.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Iterator-based: " << *it << std::endl;

    if (it != words.end() && *it == "banana") {
        std::cout << "Found: banana" << std::endl;

        std::cout << "Not found: banana" << std::endl;
    }

     
    words.insert(std::lower_bound(words.begin(), words.end(), "fig"), "fig");

     
    words.resize(6, "grape");

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << "Resized index-based: " << words[i] << std::endl;
    }

     
    for (auto it = words.begin(); it != words.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << "Resized iterator-based: " << *it << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 5, 6};

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";

    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end(), [](int a, int b) { return a < b; });

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    auto it = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), 5);
    if (it != vec.end() && *it == 5) {

    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    if (!vec.empty()) {
        vec.erase(vec.begin() + 5);
    }

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {

    int arr[] = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};
    int n = sizeof(arr) / sizeof(arr[0]);

     
    std::cout << "Array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::cout << "Array elements: ";
    for (int* ptr = arr; ptr != arr + n; ++ptr) {
        std::cout << *ptr << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(arr, arr + n);

     
    std::cout << "Sorted array elements: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << arr[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    bool found = std::binary_search(arr, arr + n, target);
    if (found) {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " found in the array." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " not found in the array." << std::endl;
    }

     
    std::vector<int> vec(arr, arr + n);

     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 3);
    std::cout << "Vector elements after insert: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);
    std::cout << "Vector elements after erase: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    vec.resize(7);
    std::cout << "Vector elements after resize: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    for (const auto& num : vec) {

    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::cout << "Elements at even indices: ";
    std::for_each(vec.begin(), vec.end(), [](int val, size_t idx) {
        if (idx % 2 == 0) std::cout << val << " ";
    });
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::for_each(vec.begin(), vec.end(), [](int& val) {
        if (val % 2 != 0) val *= 2;
    });
    
     
    for (const auto& num : vec) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found" << std::endl;
    }

     
    int index = 2;
    const char* message = (index < vec.size()) ? "Valid index" : "Invalid index";
    std::cout << message << std::endl;

     
    auto it_to_erase = vec.begin() + 2;  
    if (it_to_erase >= vec.begin() && it_to_erase < vec.end()) {
        vec.erase(it_to_erase);
    }

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int new_element = 4;
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, new_element);  

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    size_t new_size = 10;
    vec.resize(new_size, 0);  

     
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";

        std::cout << target << " not found." << std::endl;

    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";

    return 0;

// BEGIN C++ PROGRAM
#include <iostream>
int main() {
[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
     
    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 2, 9, 1, 7};

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements (index-based): ";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::cout << "Vector elements (iterator-based): ";
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());

     
    std::cout << "Sorted vector: ";
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int target = 7;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " found at position: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Element " << target << " not found in the vector." << std::endl;
    }

     
    int new_element = 4;
    vec.insert(std::upper_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), new_element), new_element);

     
    std::cout << "Vector after inserting " << new_element << ": ";
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    int erase_target = 2;
    auto it = std::find(vec.begin(), vec.end(), erase_target);
    if (it != vec.end()) {
        vec.erase(it);
    }

     
    std::cout << "Vector after erasing " << erase_target << ": ";
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    size_t new_size = 3;
    vec.resize(new_size);

     
    std::cout << "Vector resized to " << new_size << ": ";
    for (const auto& elem : vec) {
        std::cout << elem << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

    std::vector<int> vec = {5, 3, 8, 4, 2};
    
     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        std::cout << vec[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    std::sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    int target = 4;
    auto lb = std::lower_bound(vec.begin(), vec.end(), target);
    if (lb != vec.end() && *lb == target) {
        std::cout << "Found " << target << " at position: " << std::distance(vec.begin(), lb) << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << target << " not found." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    vec.insert(vec.begin() + 2, 10);
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    vec.erase(vec.begin() + 3);
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
    
     
    vec.resize(4);
    
     
    for (auto it = vec.begin(); it != vec.end(); ++it) {
        std::cout << *it << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

    for (const auto& num : vec) {
